Night a short update for new travelers
With that in mind
Travelers, here is a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep your pet details current and share any comfort needs before check in. We handle routine desk work for companion animals every day, and steady, respectful communication helps us match each traveler with the right care plan.

Our team looks at species, temperament, and general comfort when preparing support for the trip. If your pet is nervous, energetic, elderly, or simply used to a certain routine, let us know early so we can keep things smooth. Ziggy-style travel buddies do best when their basics are set and their carriers are ready.

If you are traveling with a companion animal, bring your documents, stay reachable, and speak with us as soon as anything changes. We are here to keep the process calm and clear from start to finish.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with your travel plans.
